mentions.name: Custom poker rules app
mentions.description: An app for customizing poker rules to support as many variants as possible, including extra streets, antes, throwaway cards, passing cards, multiple boards, and multiple decks, ideally to stumble across new variants; the author also researched lesser-known home variants via a Reddit thread.
mentions.audience: Home poker game players experimenting with and discovering variants
mentions.source_excerpt: Then specifically I was making an app which let me customise rules for poker - extra streets, antes, throwaway cards, passing cards, multiple boards, multiple decks, etc to support as many variants as possible, and ideally, stumble across new ones.

evidence.value: Then specifically I was making an app which let me customise rules for poker - extra streets, antes, throwaway cards, passing cards, multiple boards, multiple decks, etc to support as many variants as possible, and ideally, stumble across new ones.
